name: Wisconsin 4-H Summer Academy
org: University of Wisconsin-Madison Division of Extension, Wisconsin 4-H
what_you_do: Teens stay on the UW-Madison campus for five days. They pick a career and college track such as farming, AI, cars, cooking or health.
who_can_apply: Wisconsin youth in grades 8 to 11. Each track has its own grade range.
pay_detail: $150 per youth, covers lodging, meals, bus and activities. State scholarships are available.
deadline_text: Registration opens March 8 and closes April 25, 2027. Full refund if you cancel before it closes.
how_to_apply: Register in 4-H Online (make a profile if you are new). A paper form is also on the 4-H site. Apply for a scholarship during registration.
notes: The page says track details are labeled 2026 and may change for 2027.
